changeSet.sql:
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS v_colombian_journal_export;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW v_colombian_journal_export AS SELECT -- Fixed value fields (always the same) 0 as MOV_MOVIMIENTO, TO_CHAR(je.entry_date, 'YYYYMM') as MES_MESCONTABLE, gl.gl_code as CTA_CUENTA, 'IT' as EMP_EMPRESA, '99' as EMP_EMPFL, je.amount as MOV_VALOR,
-- Transaction type mapping (default since we can't join with loan_transaction) '40' as TPC_TIPOCOMPROB,
-- Cost center logic CASE WHEN gl.classification_enum IN (1, 2) THEN '99' -- ASSET, LIABILITY ELSE '5320000' -- INCOME, EXPENSE END as CeCo,
-- Client information c.external_id as TER_TERCERO, '' as TER_DIGVER, -- Empty as per specification '' as TER_GRUPO, -- Empty as per specification
-- Currency and exchange rate (fixed for COP) '1' as MON_MONEDA, -- Colombian Peso '' as TRM_FECHA, -- Empty as per specification '' as MOV_VLROTRAMON, -- Empty as per specification '' as MOV_VLRTRM, -- Empty as per specification
-- VAT handling CASE WHEN gl.classification_enum IN (3, 4) AND je.amount > 0 THEN '3' -- VAT for INCOME/EXPENSE ELSE '' -- No VAT END as CPT_CPTOTRIBUTA, '' as MOV_PORCENTAJE, -- Empty as per specification '' as MOV_VLRBASE, -- Empty as per specification
-- Document reference COALESCE(je.transaction_id, '') as MOV_DCMTO, '' as MOV_AFECTADCMTO, -- Empty as per specification
-- Dates je.entry_date as MOV_FECHADCMTO, je.entry_date as MOV_FINI, je.entry_date as MOV_FFIN,
-- Nature (Debit/Credit) CASE je.type_enum WHEN 1 THEN 1 -- DEBIT WHEN 2 THEN 2 -- CREDIT ELSE 1 -- Default to DEBIT END as NAT,
-- Additional fields (empty as per specification) '' as CPC_CPTOCOMP, '' as TPD_TIPODOC, '' as SCO_SUBDIVCOM,
-- Description COALESCE(je.description, '') as MENCONCEPTO, je.entry_date as MOV_FECHA,
-- Status and user fields 'S' as MOV_ESTADO, COALESCE(gl.parent_id, 0) as MOV_CTAPADRE, '' as TER_GRANCONT, '' as TER_REGIVA, '' as MOV_BASERETIVA, '' as MOV_CAUSARETIVA, '' as TER_AUTORETENEDOR, '' as MOV_CAUSARETEFTE, '' as MOV_BASERETEFTE, '' as MOV_VLRDIFBASE, '' as MOV_VLRDIFMON, '' as MOV_MOVPADRE, '' as MOV_FECHAMOV, 'O' as MOV_USUARIO, 'S' as MOV_SECUENCIA, '' as OBR_OBRA, '' as OBR_SUBOBRA, 0 as var_intnulo, '' as tip_docafecta, 0 as var_intnulo2,
-- Additional context fields for filtering je.office_id, je.entity_type_enum, je.entity_id, je.transaction_id, gl.classification_enum
FROM acc_gl_journal_entry je JOIN acc_gl_account gl ON je.account_id = gl.id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON je.entity_id = c.id AND je.entity_type_enum = 1 WHERE je.office_id IS NOT NULL AND je.entry_date IS NOT NULL;
